description: We are a passionate team interested in space, technology, engineering, innovation, and solving real-world problems. We love turning creative ideas into practical solutions and exploring what lies beyond what we already know. Together, we want to connect the heritage of the UAE with the future of space and technology and build something that can make a real impact.
summary: Multi-sensor NASA Earth observation and machine learning to decode UAE post-rain ecological memory.​
